checks.title: README file exists
checks.fix: Add a README.md at the repository root.

checks.title: README opens with one sentence that says what the project does
checks.fix: Open the README with a single sentence: what it is, for whom, and the main benefit.

checks.title: README shows a demo GIF, video or screenshot near the top
checks.fix: Add a demo GIF or screenshot in the first screen of the README.

checks.title: README installs in one command
checks.fix: Add an Installation section whose first code block is a single command.

checks.title: README has a usage section with an example
checks.fix: Add a Usage section with a runnable example, a table of commands or a screenshot.

checks.title: README tells people how to contribute
checks.fix: Add a Contributing section or a link to CONTRIBUTING.md.

checks.title: README length is between 300 and 5000 words
checks.fix: Bring the README to 300-5000 words: explain the problem, features, install and usage.

checks.title: Repository description is set
checks.fix: Set a repository description of 10-350 characters that says what the project does.

checks.title: Repository has at least 5 pertinent topics
checks.fix: Add at least 5 topics that match the language, type and domain of the project.

checks.title: Repository homepage URL is set
checks.fix: Set the repository homepage to the docs, website or package page.

checks.title: Repository has a custom social preview image
checks.fix: Upload a 1280x640 social preview image in the repository settings.

checks.title: License is recognised by GitHub
checks.fix: Add a standard LICENSE file (for example MIT or Apache-2.0) that GitHub recognises.

checks.title: Project is installable from a release or a package registry
checks.fix: Publish a release with downloadable assets, or document the registry install command.

checks.title: Releases use semantic version tags
checks.fix: Tag releases with semantic versions such as v1.2.0.

checks.title: Changes are documented in a changelog or release notes
checks.fix: Add a CHANGELOG.md or write release notes for each release.

checks.title: CONTRIBUTING file exists
checks.fix: Add a CONTRIBUTING.md that explains how to set up, test and submit changes.

checks.title: Code of conduct exists
checks.fix: Add a CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md (for example the Contributor Covenant).

checks.title: Issue templates exist
checks.fix: Add issue templates for bug reports and feature requests in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/.

checks.title: Pull request template exists
checks.fix: Add a .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with a short checklist.

checks.title: Open issues are labelled for first-time contributors
checks.fix: Create a 'good first issue' label and apply it to a few small, well-described issues.

checks.title: Security policy exists
checks.fix: Add a SECURITY.md that says how to report a vulnerability privately.

checks.title: Project had a commit in the last 90 days
checks.fix: Ship a recent commit before launching, so visitors see an active project.

checks.title: CI runs and passes on the default branch
checks.fix: Add a CI workflow that runs the tests, and keep the default branch green.

checks.title: Open issues get an answer within 7 days
checks.fix: Answer or label the open issues that have no reply.
